text: Hegseth on Iran: "They're coming in our direction. The talks have been productive. I think they know where it needs to go."

text: On Taiwan,@SecWarHegseth: "The policy we have on Taiwan is the same as it was at the beginning of this administration. The only change you might see is how we talk about the entirety of it. ... But our stance on Taiwan remains unchanged, just as the president said when we came

text: I asked Secretary Hegseth about this comment that 'any deal will be a good deal' moments later and he responded, "I love the disingenuous questions from the disingenuous press. I said it will be a good deal. That’s a very important clarification that maybe CNN can get right.”
translated_text: 稍后，我向赫格塞斯国务卿询问了“任何协议都将是一笔好协议”的言论，他回答说：“我喜欢不诚实的媒体提出的不诚实的问题。我说这将是一笔好协议。这是一个非常重要的澄清，也许 CNN 可以做出正确的解释。”
